notes.title: A Night In Berlin Turns 1 Year Old!
notes.notes:
Today marks the one year anniversary of A Night In Berlin's release. It's been a bit of a crazy year for us, we really didn't expect the response we've received from all of you! 
When we started working on Berlin 3 years ago it was just a little side project while development was stalled on an entirely different game. As we kept working on it, Berlin's scope grew in scale, with more and more people getting involved. Needless to say it's been an amazing experience getting to work with so many talented developers and voice actors, and having such a large outpouring of support for what we made!

As for what we've been up to? Life, among other things. We released during the pandemic, which was a lot to say the least. With COVID still around we've tried to get a few patches out, and a tiny little content update with the Speedrun & Easy modes, but we've had a lot on our plates aside from Berlin. 
It's a game that's close to our hearts, but it's about time for us to move on to something new! It goes without saying that we are developing a new title with Unlimina Software and Bad Smile Media. We're still in the early stages of preproduction but we will keep you in the loop as things unfold.

Until then, we hope you all continue to enjoy our game! If you're into speedrunning, Berlins speedrunning community is still going strong! The World Record of 3m 13s still hasn't been beat! If you're more into music, our Support Pack & Official Soundtrack are on sale again for 75% off for the next week to celebrate our anniversary! It's just $2.50 for the entire soundtrack, development documentary and some backgrounds! 

Thank you again and much love from the Berlin Team!

notes.title: A Night In Berlin v1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you so much for all of the support we've received over the last 7 months! This patch addresses two of the more prominent bugs that's been reported, so we wanted to roll it out quickly for those players experiencing it.

CHANGELOG:

- Fixed the issue with Level 7's completion not sending a trigger for Level 8 to unlock.

- Fixed issue causing A Night In Berlin to launch Steam VR.

- Various minor bug fixes.

Thank you again for all of your support! If you have any other bugs to report please post them on the Bug Reports discussion page or on our Discord server!

notes.title: EASY MODE & SPEEDRUN MODE Available Now! A Night In Berlin v1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello agents, we're finally releasing A Night In Berlin v1.3 which includes two new optional modes: EASY MODE and SPEEDRUN MODE, as well as some quality of life improvements.

CHANGELOG:

- Added EASY MODE. It can be accessed from the 'OPTIONS' menu.
    - Enemies have slower reaction times.
    - The player character can take 1 extra bullet before dying.
    - Franz is given one spare bullet per level.
    - Knife-wielding enemies have a reduced radius.

- Added SPEEDRUN MODE. A stopwatch will display in the top right-hand corner, and all cutscenes will be skipped.

- Organized 'OPTIONS' menu into tabs.

- Added mouse sensitivity and invert settings.

- Added an option to clear all save data*

*To unlock missing achievements for intel collection, players will need to clear their save data and recollect all intel.


Thank you again for all of your support! The teams at Bad Smile and Unlimina are super excited to see such a positive response to our first project! As always, please let us know about any issues or bugs you come across so we can fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: A Night In Berlin Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thank you again for your patience as we work on these achievement issues. Hopefully, with this most recent patch, you should be able to unlock any achievements that have been causing you trouble.

CHANGELOG:

- Added a 'RESTART' button to the pause menu.

- Added a glowing effect a bullet decal to the ammo crates to make them more visible.

- Fixed a bug where Terry could run automatically after rolling and letting go of the sprint key.

- Fixed a bug (again) where some level based achievements wouldn't unlock*

- Added additional cutscene between Level 3 and Level 4.

*[i]To unlock missing achievements for completed levels, you must launch the following level from the level select screen. For example, to unlock the Level 3 Achievement, launch Level 4. As soon as the cutscene begins you will have your achievement. [/i]

Thank you again for your support! Please make sure to report any more issues to us via our Discord or on our Bug Reports Discussions page!

notes.title: A Night In Berlin Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for playing and reporting your issues to us! Here's a list of fixes we made to A Night In Berlin.

CHANGELOG:

- Fixed some sounds not obeying volume sliders.

- Fixed Randy's knife pointing the wrong way when held.

- Fixed an achievement unlock issue after Level 8.

- Made some minor layout changes to Level 5.


Thank you again for your support! Please make sure to report any more issues to us via our Discord or on our Bug Reports Discussions page!

notes.title: A Night In Berlin Is Officially Released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! It's crazy for us to think we finally put a game out into the world for people to play. But we actually did it!

However, we aren't done yet. We want to make sure that A Night In Berlin is the best it can possibly be. So, for now, we will be fixing known bugs and working hard on improving the core game. 

We were lucky enough to have a select few play the pre-release build of the game to test balance and stability. Through that, we have found a few small issues that we are already hard at work on fixing, but we know there could be more bugs that we have not yet found.

That's where you all come in! We would love to hear what you think about A Night In Berlin, and also to know if you come across any issues during your time spent with the game. 

You can report bugs on the Unlimina Software Discord sever under the channel #bug-reports. You can join the Discord server here: [url=https://discord.gg/3XU3AxS]https://discord.gg/3XU3AxS[/url]

You can also report bugs on our Discussions page, we have a pinned post titled: Send Us Your Bug Reports! 

Thank you again for supporting us, we are so grateful that you are giving A Night In Berlin a chance. Our team is proud of what we have done so far but we know we can always improve.


Sincerely,
Unlimited Software & Bad Smile Media
